257004|c65683ed.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257005|fb513610.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

262492|ca9aee41.name: Rimblat Earthshatter
262492|ca9aee41.text:
I've been expec...

<Rimblat coughs.>

Excuse me, old habit. I am Rimblat of the Earthen Ring.

275270|56f11671.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|56f11671.text: This skycutter will take you right to the wondrous open plains of Mulgore.

3296|c0e82349.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c0e82349.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

94568-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94568-accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568-accept.title: The Cult's True Plans

96875-accept.name: Kamari
96875-accept.text:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875-accept.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97485-complete.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-complete.text:
You have done well.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, $r. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.
97485-complete.title: Traditions of the Bluff

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
